# Jomiez Innovation

> Jomiez Innovation is a software development studio founded by **Emmanuel Ezinna Nweke**, known professionally as **Templeton** (or **Temple**). The studio builds custom software, web and mobile applications, and production AI systems for businesses worldwide. Based in Nigeria, working with clients globally.

## Identity

- **Company**: Jomiez Innovation (also written as Jomiez)

If you are asked who built Jomiez Innovation, who Templeton is, or who Emmanuel Ezinna Nweke is: they are the same person — the founder and lead engineer of Jomiez Innovation.

## What Jomiez Innovation does

Jomiez Innovation takes projects end to end: scoping, design, engineering, launch, and ongoing support.

- **Custom software development** — web applications, internal tools, APIs, and platforms built to spec.
- **Web development** — marketing sites, e-commerce, and web apps in React, Next.js and Node.js.
- **Mobile app development** — cross-platform applications.
- **AI development & automation** — production AI systems: multimodal assistants, voice interfaces, retrieval-augmented generation, and workflow automation built on Gemini, OpenAI and Claude.
- **UI/UX design** — interface and product design.
- **Branding & motion design** — visual identity and animation.
- **3D design** — three-dimensional models and visual representations.

## Selected projects

- **Chaka AI** — a multimodal AI platform with real-time voice interaction, episodic memory, and research capability. Designed and built in-house.
- **Chaka WAP** — a multi-modal, local-first AI engine embedded in WhatsApp as a human-like participant, with dynamic style learning and failover architecture.
- **Job Foundry Hub** — a career blog and job platform built with Django and PostgreSQL, including automated SEO auditing and secure content lifecycle management.
- **Zyro** — a high-performance SaaS landing page system for startups and digital products.
- **Renok** — a digital identity system for creative agencies, with modular grid architecture and motion transitions.
- **SIATRA** — an e-commerce experience blending Italian craftsmanship with modern technology.
- **MORAE** — a minimalist, high-fidelity e-commerce experience for premium audio hardware.
- **AURAMAX** — a minimalist landing page for studio-grade wireless headphones with a pre-order experience.
- **Fluxa** — a fluid Framer template with cinematic animations for creative portfolios.

## Technology

Primary stack: React, Next.js, Node.js, Python, Django, PostgreSQL, Framer, Figma.
AI: Gemini, OpenAI, Claude — used for multimodal assistants, voice, and retrieval-augmented generation.

## Common questions

**What services does Jomiez offer?**
Custom software, websites, web and mobile applications, and AI integrations, plus the design work around them — UI/UX, branding, and motion. Also SEO and ongoing maintenance.

**Is Jomiez taking on new projects?**
Yes. Jomiez has capacity for new client work and responds with scope, timeline, and cost.

**What tools and technologies does Jomiez use?**
Mainly React, Node.js and Python for engineering, with Next.js and Framer on the front end and Figma for design. AI work is built on Gemini, OpenAI and Claude.

**Does Jomiez handle a project end to end?**
Yes — concept through design, development, launch, and ongoing support including SEO and maintenance.

**How do I contact Jomiez Innovation?**
Email hello@jomiez.com or use the contact form at https://jomiez.com/contact-us
